limitations: No Digital Macaroni hands-on feedback, helpdesk, AI, migration, billing, or support test was completed.
The product expanded from feedback software into a broad support suite, so older feedback may describe a smaller product.
Negative stability and billing accounts are important but much smaller than the positive review pools.

claims.statement: Featurebase launched publicly as a feedback board on August 29, 2021 and has since expanded into feedback and customer support software.
The product now combines feedback boards, roadmaps, changelogs, surveys, a help center, support inbox, and an AI support agent.
Annual seat prices are Free for one seat, $29 for Growth, $59 for Professional, and $99 for Enterprise. Month-to-month prices are $37, $75, and $129 for the paid tiers.
Fibi AI costs $0.49 per resolved conversation. Paid Copilot use beyond the included allowance costs $19 per agent monthly, and whitelabeling costs $69 monthly.
Combining feedback and support work, a clean interface, quick setup, customization, and responsive help are the strongest positive themes.
AI answers can be wrong and need a person to review or take over.
A small group describes stability, billing, and support failures despite support being a broad positive theme.

scoreRationale.onboarding: The core tools are described as easy to set up, but a full migration needs careful identity, history, and workflow checks.
scoreRationale.product: The connected feedback-to-support record is useful; the suite is still expanding and AI needs supervision.
scoreRationale.support: Strong positive pattern with a small but serious negative tail.
scoreRationale.billing: Seat, AI-resolution, Copilot, outbound email, translation, and branding charges require a full usage estimate.
scoreRationale.overall: Featurebase is attractive when feedback and support belong in one system. Test the complete loop and calculate a realistic monthly bill before switching.

conflictsAndUnknowns: Many accounts praise support while isolated cases describe very poor incident handling.
Consolidation can reduce tool switching, but it also increases the impact of an outage or weak module.
No end-to-end workflow, AI accuracy, import, permissions, billing, or support test was completed.
